| Metric | Value | Benchmark |

| Driver | Impact |
|--------|--------|

| **E‑commerce Growth** | International expansion, Prime membership growth, and logistics investments keep revenue rising. |
| **Advertising & Subscription** | Increasing ad spend and subscription services (Prime Video, Music) diversify revenue streams. |
| **Innovation & Acquisitions** | Strategic acquisitions (e.g., Whole Foods, MGM) broaden Amazon’s ecosystem. |

| Risk | Description |
|------|-------------|

| **Margin Compression** | Rising logistics costs and commodity prices could squeeze margins. |
| **Interest Rate Sensitivity** | Higher rates increase borrowing costs and may dampen consumer spending. |
| **Valuation Concerns** | The high P/E/PEG ratios mean any slowdown in growth could trigger a sharp correction. |
